rows.label: SOURCE_MISMATCH
rows.reason: The P-squared source has one Q factor; correlation has Q squared.
rejected_mutations: replace single Q by Q squared

rows.label: WRONG_TRANSFORM_POINT
rows.reason: The correct shifted physical-Y zero is p=w+epsilon, with no conjugation.
rejected_mutations: pair at conjugate w
omit positive damping shift

rows.label: WRONG_ZERO_JET_ORDER
rows.reason: Differentiating a multiplicity-m zero makes Y have order m-1.
rejected_mutations: use zero multiplicity m as Y order

rows.label: WRONG_JET_COEFFICIENT
rows.reason: The exact derivative and Laplace parity give (-1)^m R J m! once.
rejected_mutations: extra factorial
omit parity sign

rows.label: EXCEPTIONAL_POINT_MISMATCH
rows.reason: A removable pole product is evaluated by its limit, not 0 times 0.
rejected_mutations: totalized zero times pole at exceptional point

rows.label: WRONG_SHIFT_BUDGET
rows.reason: The exact predecessor inverses attain distinct 6 and 12 budgets.
rejected_mutations: swap lambda and minus-eta inverse budgets

rows.label: UNSUPPORTED_SPECTRAL_IDENTIFICATION
rows.reason: A separated selector lambda and arbitrarily small strict parity gap remain distinct.
rejected_mutations: identify lambda with minus eta
replace actual parity gap by depth third

rows.label: WRONG_CARRIER_MAP
rows.reason: A nonunitary D0 needs its inverse in the even reconstruction.
rejected_mutations: drop D0 inverse

rows.label: WRONG_ADJOINT_IDENTITY
rows.reason: The complex odd identity requires the adjoint and its reconstruction minus sign.
rejected_mutations: drop strict-odd minus sign
substitute D0 inverse for D0 adjoint
treat D0 as unitary in the odd ray

rows.label: INAPPLICABLE_BRANCH
rows.reason: The even carrier guard rejects a nonzero odd vector before using M4.
rejected_mutations: apply even residual premise to odd vector

rows.label: OMITTED_NORMAL_TERM
rows.reason: The retained K3 continuum defect is the nonzero corrected normal term.
rejected_mutations: set neutral continuum defect to zero

rows.label: WRONG_SCHUR_SPACE
rows.reason: The full detector Schur completion fails after a nonzero complement component is lost.
rejected_mutations: replace two-dimensional detector complement by first shell

rows.label: INCOMPLETE_FORCING
rows.reason: All four signed prime arguments and the nonzero interior contribution are retained.
rejected_mutations: delete reflected fourth prime history
discard original interior history

rows.label: WRONG_COMPRESSION
rows.reason: The legal K3 response has a nonzero pole-normal component removed by Qe.
rejected_mutations: replace neutral response by legal response

rows.label: UNPROVED_PROPERTY_TRANSPORT
rows.reason: A positive source does not make a distinct negative-eigenvalue ground positive.
rejected_mutations: transfer source positivity to sign-changing finite ground

rows.label: MISSING_DOMAIN_LIMIT_THEOREM
rows.reason: An invisible adjoint-kernel component persists despite finite observed decay.
rejected_mutations: promote observed finite decay to full range membership
